40 Boys Quiff Ideas

September 10, 2026September 10, 2026 by PeteBurrows
Listen to audio version of this article

Instaread

The Quiff hairstyle is one that gives boys an edge and style with added volume, texture, and attitude. With various versions ranging from traditional short quiffs to contemporary textured quiffs, there are many options to suit all types of hair.

This hairstyle is a perfect choice for boys on a day out at school, at parties, and family functions, among others. It can either be worn with fades or in longer styles. There are 40 boys quiff hairstyles for you to try out!

1. Classic Gentleman Quiff

A neatly sculpted quiff gives young boys a polished appearance with timeless charm. Shorter sides create a clean silhouette while longer hair rises naturally across front. A touch of styling cream adds flexible hold without making hair appear stiff. This handsome cut works beautifully for school events, family gatherings, or celebrations. Subtle volume keeps everything youthful while carrying a refined gentlemanly character.

2. Textured Adventure Quiff

Messy texture brings playful energy into this effortlessly cool boys quiff style. Layers across top create movement while tapered sides maintain a tidy outline. Finger styling works wonderfully when creating casually tousled peaks with natural character. Matte paste can enhance separation without producing excessive shine. This adventurous variation suits energetic personalities with a carefree attitude.

3. Mini Pompadour Quiff

A miniature pompadour introduces sophisticated volume while keeping proportions suitable for younger boys. Longer front sections sweep upward before curving gently toward one side. Faded sides sharpen contrast around elevated layers beautifully. Light mousse can provide structure while preserving soft movement throughout. This dapper option feels particularly striking during weddings and formal family occasions.

4. Side-Swept School Quiff

Side-swept styling gives a traditional quiff a charming academic personality. Front strands travel diagonally across forehead while shorter sides keep everything organized. A subtle taper prevents excessive bulk around ears and neckline. Low-shine styling cream creates enough control for busy school mornings. This handsome haircut balances youthful innocence with polished sophistication.

5. Curly Top Quiff

Natural curls add personality and dimension across this lively quiff variation. Shorter sides create contrast while curly texture rises naturally across front. A lightweight curl cream can define individual coils without creating unwanted stiffness. Soft volume gives this haircut an energetic appearance suitable for everyday adventures. This option celebrates natural texture while maintaining a stylish silhouette.

6. Low Fade Quiff

A low fade creates understated contrast beneath a voluminous quiff. Gradual tapering begins near ears and blends smoothly toward longer upper sections. Hair across front receives enough length for controlled upward styling. Matte pomade can provide dependable shape without excessive gloss. This modern haircut looks youthful while carrying a remarkably clean finish.

7. High Fade Quiff

High faded sides make a quiff appear dramatically taller and sharper. Considerable contrast develops between closely trimmed sides and lifted upper hair. Front layers can sweep backward for an energetic contemporary finish. Strong styling clay works well when extra hold becomes necessary. This bold haircut suits boys who enjoy expressive and confident appearances.

8. Messy Morning Quiff

A deliberately untidy quiff delivers relaxed personality without appearing completely unkempt. Choppy layers create irregular texture across front and upper sections. Fingers can shape individual strands for a naturally spontaneous finish. Lightweight wax provides enough control while preserving loose movement. This playful style works especially well for casual weekends and outdoor activities.

9. Tapered Classic Quiff

Gentle tapering gives this traditional quiff a softer and more versatile appearance. Hair gradually shortens around temples while maintaining substantial length across crown. Front strands receive upward direction with a subtle backward sweep. Styling cream keeps texture flexible throughout busy afternoons. This balanced haircut fits school days as comfortably as special occasions.

10. Blonde Beach Quiff

Sun-kissed blonde hair looks especially charming when shaped into a breezy quiff. Longer upper strands create airy volume while tapered sides provide definition. Slightly tousled texture gives those lighter strands a relaxed coastal personality. Sea-salt spray can amplify natural movement with minimal effort. This cheerful haircut brings youthful freshness into everyday styling.

11. Spiky Quiff Fusion

Sharp spikes transform a conventional quiff into something considerably more adventurous. Individual strands rise prominently across front while shorter sides emphasize vertical texture. A firm styling wax helps maintain those energetic peaks throughout active days. Uneven separation keeps this haircut from looking overly formal or rigid. This daring variation suits boys with playful confidence and expressive style.

12. Soft Feathered Quiff

Feathered layers create gentle movement across a softer interpretation of traditional quiff styling. Longer strands sweep upward before falling naturally toward one side. Tapered edges prevent excessive weight around temples and neckline. A small amount of lightweight cream keeps everything touchably smooth. This elegant haircut feels polished while retaining a wonderfully youthful quality.

13. Disconnected Quiff

A disconnected quiff creates noticeable separation between long upper hair and shorter sides. Longer strands across crown stand prominently above closely trimmed sections. This dramatic contrast gives facial features greater definition and visual structure. Matte clay offers reliable control without overpowering natural texture. Boys seeking an edgy haircut can easily make this distinctive style their own.

14. Curved Front Quiff

A curved front creates graceful movement rather than sharp vertical height. Longer strands lift from roots before bending gently backward across crown. Tapered sides keep proportions balanced around younger facial features. Flexible pomade supports that rounded shape without creating a helmet-like appearance. This refined option works beautifully for photographs and celebratory gatherings.

15. Short Crop Quiff

A compact quiff offers stylish volume without requiring substantial hair length. Short upper layers receive slight elevation across front for subtle dimension. Tapered sides maintain a crisp appearance around ears and neckline. Matte styling paste adds texture while keeping daily grooming wonderfully simple. This practical haircut suits active boys who prefer fuss-free styling.

16. Wavy Quiff Wonder

Natural waves create beautiful texture throughout this relaxed quiff design. Longer front sections rise gently before falling into soft irregular bends. Shorter sides enhance those waves while preventing unnecessary visual heaviness. Curl-enhancing cream can preserve definition without sacrificing natural movement. This charming haircut celebrates wavy texture through an effortlessly fashionable shape.

17. Side Part Quiff

A defined side part introduces structure within a voluminous quiff. Hair above parting sweeps upward while opposite sections remain neatly controlled. Tapered sides create additional sharpness around an already polished silhouette. Medium-hold pomade can maintain separation throughout long occasions. This timeless variation works particularly well with smart shirts and tailored outfits.

18. Undercut Quiff

An undercut creates powerful contrast beneath longer upper hair. Closely trimmed sides expose a distinct boundary before dramatic volume begins above. Front sections can sweep backward for a sleek contemporary appearance. Strong styling cream helps preserve shape during active afternoons. This statement haircut gives boys an unmistakably modern edge.

19. Natural Volume Quiff

Natural volume creates an authentic quiff without requiring excessive styling products. Hair remains moderately long across front while sides receive gentle tapering. Brushing upward during drying can encourage lasting height and movement. A small amount of matte cream finishes loose strands without weighing them down. This understated style feels effortless, comfortable, and wonderfully age-appropriate.

20. Retro Schoolboy Quiff

Retro inspiration gives this schoolboy quiff a charming old-fashioned character. Front hair rises neatly before sweeping backward with controlled movement. Scissor-cut sides preserve softness instead of creating an overly dramatic fade. Light pomade adds gentle structure while maintaining a classic finish. This nostalgic hairstyle looks particularly handsome during family portraits and formal celebrations.

21. Faux Hawk Quiff

A faux hawk introduces rebellious energy while keeping quiff proportions relatively wearable. Central strands receive extra height while surrounding sections gradually blend outward. Textured tips create separation without requiring extremely sharp spikes. Strong matte wax provides dependable control during energetic activities. This adventurous haircut suits boys who enjoy contemporary styling with plenty of attitude.

22. Brushed Back Quiff

Brushed-back styling gives a quiff sleek sophistication with a modern gentlemanly character. Front hair rises slightly before traveling backward across crown. Tapered sides maintain clean proportions without overwhelming youthful facial features. A lightweight pomade creates smooth control while preserving subtle volume. This versatile look transitions beautifully from school functions into formal celebrations.

23. Textured Fringe Quiff

A textured fringe introduces youthful softness across a lifted quiff. Front strands remain slightly uneven while upper layers create gentle volume behind them. Tapered sides frame facial features without appearing excessively severe. Matte paste enhances separation across those naturally irregular strands. This playful design works wonderfully for boys who prefer relaxed fashionable haircuts.

24. Mid Fade Quiff

A mid fade delivers stronger contrast while maintaining balanced proportions around face. Hair gradually shortens from temple level before transitioning into fuller upper sections. Front strands rise prominently with lightly textured tips. Styling clay offers reliable support during school days and weekend activities. This contemporary haircut provides a confident appearance without becoming excessively dramatic.

25. Long Top Quiff

Extra length across top allows greater creativity within this expressive quiff. Longer front sections can rise dramatically before sweeping backward or sideways. Shorter sides emphasize upper volume while keeping overall proportions controlled. A flexible styling product encourages experimentation with different finishes. This versatile option suits boys who enjoy changing their hairstyle frequently.

26. Feathered Side Quiff

Feathered layers create graceful movement across a side-directed quiff. Longer strands sweep diagonally while tapered sides maintain a tidy outline. Soft texture prevents this hairstyle from feeling overly rigid or formal. Lightweight styling cream can preserve movement throughout a busy day. This sophisticated variation looks especially appealing with smart-casual clothing.

27. Tousled Blonde Quiff

Tousled blonde strands create a bright and energetic appearance across this casual quiff. Uneven layers rise naturally while shorter sides keep overall shape controlled. Finger styling produces a wonderfully imperfect finish without complicated grooming routines. Matte wax can emphasize texture while preserving flexible movement. This cheerful hairstyle feels youthful, carefree, and effortlessly fashionable.

28. Skin Fade Quiff

A skin fade creates maximum contrast beneath elevated upper hair. Sides taper down dramatically before reaching an almost bare finish around lower areas. Longer crown sections receive strong upward direction for noticeable visual impact. Firm clay helps maintain height during long events or active afternoons. This striking haircut works best for boys wanting a bold contemporary statement.

29. Classic Taper Quiff

A classic taper keeps this quiff sophisticated without introducing dramatic contrasts. Hair gradually becomes shorter around temples and neckline while retaining softness. Front volume remains moderate with a gentle backward sweep. Styling cream provides manageable control while preserving natural texture. This dependable haircut suits almost every casual or semi-formal setting.

30. Mohawk-Inspired Quiff

A narrow central ridge gives this quiff subtle mohawk-inspired character. Hair across crown receives concentrated height while surrounding sections stay considerably shorter. Textured tips make those elevated strands appear dynamic rather than overly rigid. Strong styling wax can support dramatic height when desired. This fearless variation brings youthful rebellion into modern boys’ grooming.

31. Side Volume Quiff

Side-focused volume offers an elegant alternative to vertically lifted quiff designs. Longer strands sweep upward before traveling toward one side with graceful direction. Shorter sections provide visual balance around temples and ears. Medium-hold cream keeps movement controlled without creating excessive stiffness. This polished haircut works beautifully during dinners, celebrations, and school functions.

32. Curly Fade Quiff

A curly fade quiff combines defined texture with clean tapered sides. Natural curls gather upward across front while faded edges create strong structural contrast. Curl cream can enhance definition while preserving softness throughout upper sections. Finger shaping works better than aggressive brushing for maintaining natural patterns. This stylish design allows curly-haired boys to showcase texture confidently.

33. Ivy League Quiff

Ivy League influence gives this quiff a sophisticated academic character. Moderately short sides blend neatly beneath a carefully shaped upper section. Front hair receives subtle elevation before sweeping naturally backward. Light pomade creates refined control without sacrificing youthful softness. This timeless haircut feels equally appropriate at school and formal family gatherings.

34. Choppy Layer Quiff

Choppy layers produce an energetic texture across this fashion-forward quiff. Uneven lengths create movement while shorter sides keep overall proportions sharp. Front strands can stand upward with deliberately irregular separation. Matte clay accentuates those layered pieces without creating excessive shine. This expressive hairstyle suits boys with bold personalities and adventurous fashion tastes.

35. Curved Side Quiff

A curved side quiff combines smooth direction with understated volume. Front hair lifts gently before bending toward one side across forehead. Tapered sides maintain a refined shape around younger facial structures. Flexible pomade can preserve that curved movement throughout long occasions. This handsome style feels polished without appearing overly mature.

36. Brushed Texture Quiff

Brushed texture adds controlled movement while retaining a naturally relaxed appearance. Upper strands receive upward brushing before settling into slightly separated sections. Short sides create a neat frame around fuller crown hair. Lightweight wax supports texture without turning strands heavy or greasy. This versatile option transitions smoothly between everyday wear and special occasions.

37. Modern Sharp Quiff

Clean lines and pronounced volume give this modern quiff a confident character. Upper hair receives deliberate height while sides remain closely tapered for contrast. Sharp texture around front creates a crisp contemporary finish. Matte clay provides structure without overwhelming natural hair movement. This stylish haircut works particularly well with modern streetwear and smart outfits.

38. Soft Side Quiff

A soft side quiff delivers subtle volume with an approachable youthful appearance. Longer front strands sweep gently sideways while shorter sides preserve neatness. Natural texture remains visible beneath flexible styling rather than heavy product. A small amount of cream can smooth flyaways without flattening volume. This understated design feels comfortable for everyday school and family life.

39. Sporty Quiff Fade

A sporty fade keeps this quiff energetic, practical, and easy to maintain. Shorter sides reduce bulk while upper hair receives moderate height across front. Textured styling creates movement without requiring lengthy grooming sessions. Matte paste offers lightweight control during outdoor games and active routines. This haircut blends athletic practicality with a distinctly fashionable finish.

40. Signature Statement Quiff

A signature quiff combines volume, texture, and individuality into one memorable haircut. Longer front sections rise confidently before sweeping backward with expressive movement. Carefully tapered sides keep dramatic upper styling visually balanced. A dependable styling clay helps maintain structure during special occasions and photographs. This standout variation gives boys a confident finishing touch with plenty of personality.
